Figure 4: Overview pipeline of our method OmniSelect. The overall process is divided into two stages: (1) Modality-Aware Dynamic Ratio Allocation that allocates the pruning ratio for each temporal group while ensuring the total pruning ratio meets the expected value; (2) Temporal Group Pruning Pipeline (TGP2) that prunes audio and video tokens based on attention score and cosine similarity score within each temporal group.
